name: Polylactic Acid (PLA)
notes: Biodegradable thermoplastic aliphatic polyester derived from renewable plant resources. Widely used in packaging and 3D printing.

name: Polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA)
notes: Bio-based polyester accumulated as energy reserve by micro-organisms. High biocompatibility and marine degradability.

name: Polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB)
notes: Homopolymer PHA with high crystallinity and stiff physical behavior similar to polypropylene.

name: Polyhydroxybutyrate-co-valerate (PHBV)
notes: Copolymer of PHB and valerate showing improved flexibility, lower melting point, and higher impact resistance.

name: Polycaprolactone (PCL)
notes: Semi-crystalline biodegradable polyester with very low melting point (~60°C). Excellent blend compatibility.

name: Poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA)
notes: FDA-approved copolymer used extensively in biomedical scaffolds, sutures, and controlled drug delivery systems.

name: Poly(glycolic acid) (PGA)
notes: High crystallinity aliphatic polyester with high tensile strength and fast hydrolytic degradation.

name: Polybutylene Succinate (PBS)
notes: Biodegradable aliphatic polyester offering melt processability similar to polyolefins and good thermal stability.

name: Polybutylene Adipate Terephthalate (PBAT)
notes: Flexible aliphatic-aromatic copolyester widely blended with starch or PLA to improve toughness.

name: Polydioxanone (PDO / PDS)
notes: Biodegradable synthetic polymer with high flexibility and strength retention. Popular in monofilament sutures.

name: Microcrystalline Cellulose (MCC)
notes: Purified partially depolymerized cellulose. Used as binder, disintegrant, and biocomposite reinforcing filler.

name: Nanocellulose (CNC / CNF)
source: Acid hydrolysis / Mechanical fibrillation of cellulose
notes: High aspect ratio nano-scale cellulosic fibers boasting exceptional stiffness, transparency, and barrier characteristics.

name: Bacterial Cellulose (BC)
notes: Ultrapure nanostructured cellulose web possessing extraordinary water holding capacity, purity, and tensile strength.

name: Carboxymethyl Cellulose (CMC)
notes: Water-soluble cellulose derivative providing thickener, hydrogel, and film-forming capabilities in food/pharma.

name: Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose (HPMC)
notes: Non-ionic water-soluble cellulose ether used in oral capsule shells, ophthalmic drops, and sustained release matrices.

name: Ethyl Cellulose (EC)
notes: Organosoluble, water-insoluble hydrophobic derivative of cellulose ideal for moisture barrier coatings.

name: Methyl Cellulose (MC)
notes: Thermally gelling water-soluble polysaccharide displaying reversible gelation upon heating.

name: Cellulose Acetate (CA)
notes: Thermoplastic cellulose derivative used in filtration membranes, protective packaging, and drug delivery.

name: Native Corn Starch
notes: Abundant natural plant carbohydrate comprising amylose and amylopectin. Fully edible and biodegradable.

name: Thermoplastic Starch (TPS)
notes: Melt-processable bio-based polymer system produced via high-shear extrusion in presence of plasticizers.

name: High Amylose Maize Starch
notes: Linear amylose-rich starch forming stronger, more moisture-resistant films than standard native starches.

name: Tapioca Starch
notes: Low amylose starch providing clear, elastic gel matrices and excellent bland taste profile.

name: Potato Starch
notes: Large granule starch containing naturally bound phosphate groups contributing high paste clarity and viscosity.

name: Chitosan (High Deacetylation >85%)
notes: Cationic amino polysaccharide exhibiting intrinsic antibacterial properties, wound healing acceleration, and film formation.

name: Chitosan (Low Deacetylation 70-80%)
notes: Chitosan variant with lower charge density, slower biodegradation rate, and modified cell adhesion properties.

name: Chitosan Acetate
notes: Water-soluble chitosan salt facilitating rapid dissolution and instantaneous antimicrobial action.

name: Chitosan Lactate
notes: Biocompatible water-soluble salt widely utilized in hydrogels, ocular formulations, and tissue adhesives.

name: Chitosan Hydrochloride
notes: Highly soluble chitosan derivative suitable for mucosal drug delivery and hemostatic dressings.

name: Sodium Alginate
notes: Linear block copolymer of guluronate and mannuronate. Crosslinks instantly with Ca2+ ions to form hydrogels.

name: Calcium Alginate
source: Ionic crosslinking of Sodium Alginate with CaCl2
notes: Insoluble ionically crosslinked hydrogel network used in advanced wound dressings, cell encapsulation, and bio-ink printing.

name: Alginic Acid
notes: Insoluble acidic form of alginate serving as disintegrant and tablet binder in pharmaceutical formulations.

name: Organosolv Lignin
notes: High purity sulfur-free aromatic biopolymer imparting high antioxidant activity and UV-blocking properties.

name: Kraft Lignin
notes: Abundant technical lignin containing thiol groups. Used as resin extender, antioxidant additive, and carbon precursor.

name: Lignosulfonate (Sodium Salt)
notes: Water-soluble anionic polyelectrolyte lignin derivative functioning as plasticizer, dispersant, and binder.

name: Type A Gelatin (Porcine)
notes: Soluble protein matrix with high gel strength (Bloom 200-300). Thermoreversible hydrogel used in capsules.

name: Type B Gelatin (Bovine)
notes: Alkali-processed gelatin with lower isoelectric point (pI ~4.8) delivering excellent clarity and dissolution behavior.

name: Cold Water Fish Gelatin
notes: Low proline/hydroxyproline content gelatin remaining liquid at room temperature; ideal for non-bovine/halal uses.

name: Bombyx Mori Silk Fibroin
notes: Fibrous protein forming anti-parallel beta-sheet crystals with remarkable toughness, biocompatibility, and optical clarity.

name: Antheraea Mylitta Silk Fibroin
notes: Non-mulberry silk protein possessing innate RGD cell-binding peptide sequences promoting enhanced cell adhesion.

name: Type I Collagen (Bovine)
notes: Primary structural ECM protein with triple-helical architecture. Standard for tissue engineering scaffolds.

name: Type II Collagen (Cartilage)
notes: Fibrillar collagen essential for articular cartilage scaffold fabrication and chondrocyte differentiation.

name: High MW Hyaluronic Acid (HMW-HA)
notes: High molecular weight (>1 MDa) non-sulfated GAG providing moisture retention, viscoelasticity, and anti-inflammatory action.

name: Low MW Hyaluronic Acid (LMW-HA)
notes: Low molecular weight (<100 kDa) HA derivative promoting tissue penetration, cell signaling, and angiogenesis.

name: High Methoxyl Pectin (HMP)
notes: Heteropolysaccharide (>50% esterified) forming gels under acidic conditions and high soluble solids content.

name: Low Methoxyl Pectin (LMP)
notes: Pectin variant (<50% esterification) gelling in presence of divalent cations (Ca2+) independent of sugar concentration.

name: Xanthan Gum
notes: High molecular weight exopolysaccharide producing pseudoplastic shear-thinning solutions with superior emulsion stability.

name: Dextran (70 kDa)
notes: Complex branched glucan used as plasma volume expander, anti-thrombotic agent, and nano-particle surface coating.

name: Pullulan
notes: Non-ionic glucan producing clear, oil-resistant, highly impermeable oxygen barrier edible films.

name: Kappa-Carrageenan
notes: Sulfated galactan forming rigid, strong gels in the presence of potassium ions.

name: Zein (Maize Protein)
notes: Proline-rich hydrophobic plant protein producing grease-resistant, water-insoluble coatings and pharmaceutical tablet films.
